name: Checker_Checklist
_about: Field added by the HomeCartel spec v1.4 (03 Fulfillment / 03 Pick, QC, Rework and Crate, QC-R5): 'a second QC after rework is visit 2; both visits are kept.' Checker_Checklist records are never overwritten across a recheck (a new row is added instead, see app/fulfillment/exception_recheck.py), so Visit_No just numbers them in creation order per SO+SKU+PAC.

fields.name: Visit_No
fields.label: Visit #
fields.helpText: QC-R5: 1 for the first QC of this item/package, 2 for the QC after its first rework, and so on. Stamped once when the record is created, never changed afterward.
